jsesh.bzr.simple
Class BzrSimpleFontBuilder

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.bzr.simple.BzrSimpleFontBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
BzrFontBuilder
public class BzrSimpleFontBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
implements BzrFontBuilder

BzrSimpleFontBuilder builds demo fonts from a BZR file. Note that in BZR files the y coordinates are oriented toward the top, whereas the "normal" orientation for Java 2D graphics is reversed. To avoid further complication, in particular in respect to font use, we conform to J2D. Created: Fri Jun 7 12:37:00 2002

Author:
Serge ROSMORDUC
